items.title: Duffy Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 17, 1995
items.q: we had a very, very great time playing together, Cleve and I and the band

ctx.x: Yeah. It’s an awesome responsibility to be in that rhythm section. Who was playing bass at that time?

Well at that particular time the first three months, I joined August 12 of 1979. And I stayed at that point a full year. And the bassist for the first three months I was there was John Clayton, who is an extraordinary player, he really is, he’s great, whether in symphonic work or straight ahead jazz. And he’s become one of the most prolific arrangers and composers and I love his writing. And he stayed for three months, but he had been on the band a few years and he wanted to settle down with his family in Los…
I think he was with the group that — we saw them not that long ago.
